mapper.insert: insert into "interviewworks_ticket"."user_data" (name, email, phone, password, birthday, permissions) values ( #{name}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{password}, '', 'USER' )
mapper.select: select SPLIT_PART(ud.email, '@', 1) as account, ud."name", ud.email, ud.phone, ud."password", ud.birthday, ud.permissions from "interviewworks_ticket"."user_data" ud where SPLIT_PART(ud.email, '@', 1) = #{account}

select permissions.code from "interviewworks_ticket"."user_data" user_data right join "interviewworks_ticket".permissions permissions on user_data.permissions = permissions.description where SPLIT_PART(user_data.email, '@', 1) = #{account}
